import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import xgboost as xgb
import os

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify columns
id_col = "Id"
target_col = "Cover_Type"
feature_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c not in [id_col, target_col]]

# Separate features and target
X_train = train[feature_cols]
y_train = train[target_col]
X_test = test[feature_cols]
test_ids = test[id_col]

# Create hold-out validation split (non-stratified to avoid class sparsity issues)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.10, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

# Convert to arrays
X_train_enc = X_tr.values
X_val_enc = X_val.values
X_test_enc = X_test.values

print(f"Training samples: {len(y_tr)}")
print(f"Validation samples: {len(y_val)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(X_test_enc)}")
print(f"Features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Train XGBoost model with appropriate parameters for multi-class classification
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=8,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    objective="multi:softmax",
    num_class=len(y_train.unique()),
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
    random_state=42,
    tree_method="hist",
    verbose_eval=False,
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

print("Training model...")
model.fit(X_train_enc, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_val_enc, y_val)], verbose=False)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set (data never used for training or tuning)
val_preds = model.predict(X_val_enc)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test_enc)

# Create submission file in required location
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission = pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_ids, target_col: test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Print only the evaluation metric as required
print(val_accuracy)
